description: Cancel a Bookd booking for the guest. First call with confirm=false to see the refund under the property's policy and tell the guest; only call with confirm=true after the guest explicitly agrees. Needs the booking_id and the email used to book. confirm=false changes nothing. confirm=true cancels for good (it cannot be undone): it releases any card hold or refunds under the policy on the property's own Stripe account, frees the dates (and cancels it in the property's booking system when it is connected), and emails the property and the guest.
name: cancel_booking
title: Cancel a booking
